Potions, keys, trophies — carried by a character, an NPC or kept in a place.
Hit points, resources and items of your hero will be here. It is the same party record, not a copy.
Fill the sheet step by step
Not a caster — hide the tab
You can bring the tab back any time: the ⋯ menu at the top, "Show the Spells tab".
This tab comes in the next update.
Unconscious but no longer rolling. The count resets on healing.
Three failures. Mark the character as fallen? The record moves to the “Fallen” section of the party, notes and items stay.
Fill the sheet from the paper one
Bonuses, saves and skills are counted from the scores.

Enter the ability scores from the paper sheet, the bonuses are counted for you. Press the circle to mark proficiency: once for proficient, twice for expertise. Press the name to add an adjustment for an item or a feat.
Search by any name of a skill
The score from the sheet, 1 to 30. The bonus is counted for you.
For items and feats, added to the skill bonus.
A note for you only, nothing is counted from it.
For items and feats, added to the number.
As on the sheet, multiclass separated by commas
Enter the scores from the paper sheet, 1 to 30. The bonuses are counted for you.
Initiative, proficiency and passive Perception are counted from the sheet.
Enter how many slots of each level your sheet has.
The spell save DC and the attack bonus are counted from it. With no ability and no slots the Spells tab is hidden.
The ability your spells depend on, set by your class. Press the tile to choose it: the save DC (difficulty class) and the attack bonus are counted from it. Leave it empty for a hero without magic.

DC (difficulty class) is the number the target must beat with a saving throw against your spell. It is 8 + proficiency bonus + spellcasting ability modifier. It changes with your level and your ability score.
The bonus you add to the d20 when a spell asks for an attack roll. It is proficiency bonus + spellcasting ability modifier. It changes with your level and your ability score.

Each tile is a spell level: the count of slots and squares, the lit ones are still free. Press a tile to open the level, then press a cell to spend it and again to bring it back. Change the number of slots with the "Edit slots" button.
Press a cell to spend it or bring it back
Spells of this level will appear here
Enter how many slots of each level your sheet has. A level with no slots is not shown.
Rage, Second Wind, Ki - whatever is spent and regained.
A long rest brings back every use and slot.

What is spent and regained: rage, ki, sorcery points. Press a square to spend a use, press an empty one to get it back. Press the name or hold a square to change the maximum. After a level up, change the maximum yourself.
Rage, Second Wind, Ki — whatever is spent and regained.
What is left is not counted again: after a level up, fix the squares by pressing them.
A template gives only the name, you enter the maximum yourself.
